The '''Listehol Campaign''' was an [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] campaign launched by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] as part of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. Its purpose was to drive out a union composed of [[Tervig]] and [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], along with [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], from the pair of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]]. An Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bannidge Holt]] emerged [[Battle of Sagma|victorious]] in the [[Sagma system/Legends|Sagma system]], then [[Siege of Zygerria|besieged]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] before it negotiated peace with the Imperials. The Listehol Campaign ended after Imperial [[Raids on Tervissis|raids]] directed by Yularen from his fleet failed to take the world of [[Tervissis]].

==Prelude==
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], a union of [[Tervig]] and [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], along with [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], had made the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] dangerous trade routes for shipping, and had also carried out raids into the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], a region near those routes. In response to these activities, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dispatched [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bannidge Holt]], to deal with the slavers and pirates as part of the campaign to regain control of that area with the [[Reconquest of the Rim]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==The campaign==
Commanding a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruisers]]&mdash;originally intended for the Corporate Sector's government, the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]&mdash;complemented by [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] launched from a few [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], Yularen [[Battle of Sagma|won]] the first engagement against the criminal union in the [[Sagma system/Legends|Sagma system]], where his fleet withstood a swarm of Sikurdian pirates.<ref name="Warfare" />

The Imperial fleet then advanced down the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and proceeded to [[Siege of Zygerria|besiege]] the world of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], an interdiction that ended after the an [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] negotiated peace with [[Unidentified Imperial Advisor|Imperial Advisor]] who arrived backed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Zygerria then served as a base of operations for Yularen's fleet, which launched a series of [[Raids on Tervissis|raids]] against the Tervig [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tervissis]]. However, the Tervig slavers proved to be intractable, and the failed Imperial offensive ended the Listehol Campaign.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Aftermath==
Holt, for his role in the campaign, became a newly minted war hero for the Empire and was later given command of a portion of the naval forces involved in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] the next year. Yularen's reputation was also raised by his successful campaign.

The raids against Tervissis were generally strategic failures and did not stop the Tervig slavers. As a result, the Empire would ultimately resort to [[Invasion of Tervissis|conquering]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] outright in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Listehol Campaign was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
